datasets.title: Italy Buildings (OpenStreetMap Export)
datasets.description: OpenStreetMap contains roughly 15.2 million buildings in this region. Based on AI-mapped estimates, this is approximately 73% of the total buildings.The average age of data for this region is 2 years ( Last edited 7 months ago ) and 3% buildings were added or updated in the last 6 months. lineage.description: Building footprints were extracted from OpenStreetMap contributions and validated using AI-mapping estimates to assess coverage completeness (approximately 73% of total buildings). Data quality metrics indicate an average age of 2 years with 3% of buildings updated in the last 6 months, providing a current spatial inventory of building structures for exposure assessment.
